verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Workers code written against standard runtime APIs that runs unmodified on other edge platforms. The 'No proprietary tools or vendor lock-in' claim refers to workflow tooling (Git, GitHub Actions, VS Code), not runtime or storage portability. The documented data access instead goes through Cloudflare-specific Bindings (KV, D1), and community users explicitly describe KV/D1 as lock-in that makes switching hard.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write code against standard runtime APIs so it runs unmodified across multiple edge platforms instead of being locked into proprietary storage/runtime APIs
